false_claims.claim: ABAP 里 `WHERE lifnr IN @<初始区间表>` 是“没有可匹配值”，不是“不限制”，所以调用方若只传 `it_iban` 而不传两个伙伴区间，两条查询都返回空，`check_iban_duplicate` 于是永远判定“无重复” (line 203)
false_claims.why_wrong: D17: the three OPTIONAL range parameters are used unconditionally as ranges, so an unsupplied range means 'no restriction' - not 'no matching value'. The report inverts the default-path behaviour and builds a 🔴 priority item (line 1707) on the inverted reading.

false_claims.claim: 只传 IBAN 区间时两条 SQL 都返回空，校验恒通过——一个“看似在校验、实际不校验”的默认路径 (line 1707)
false_claims.why_wrong: D17: an unsupplied optional range imposes no restriction, so the default path is not 'returns empty / always passes' - the same inversion restated as a top-priority finding.

false_claims.claim: `ENDLOOP` 在未进入循环体时确实置 4，逻辑成立，但中间任何一次 `READ TABLE`/`ADD` 之外的语句都可能覆盖它 (line 698)
false_claims.why_wrong: D5: the `IF sy-subrc <> 0` after `ENDLOOP` is not a loop-found test at all - it is the leftover sy-subrc of the last statement executed inside the loop body (READ TABLE / nested LOOP). The report asserts the logic holds and reduces a live defect to a fragility note.

false_claims.claim: 这是一个纯筛选方法，逻辑本身正确且高效（不复制、不 `DELETE`，一次 `FOR` 表达式完成过滤与投影） (line 1659)
false_claims.why_wrong: D19: the `WHERE is_foreign = abap_true AND is_domestic = abap_true` intersection returns an almost necessarily empty set under a method name that promises domestic types - a business-correctness defect, not correct logic.

false_claims.claim: 它复用了 SAP 自己的日期解析 FM，从而**跟随用户的日期格式设置**（`DD.MM.YYYY`、`YYYYMMDD` 等），而不是把格式写死 (line 1463)
false_claims.why_wrong: D15: `WRITE iv_datum TO lv_datxt` produces the user's display format, but `CONVERSION_EXIT_INVDT_INPUT` expects the internal format - so the chain is wrong, and the wrong result is written into the class-wide cache.

false_claims.claim: 缓存用得漂亮且安全。三张 `HASHED` 表 + `ASSIGN [ KEY primary_key ... ]` + `INSERT ... ASSIGNING` 的组合 (line 1739)
false_claims.why_wrong: D16: `INSERT ls_cache INTO TABLE gt_dg_cache ASSIGNING <ls_cache>` targets a UNIQUE-key table, so a duplicate key leaves the field symbol unassigned and `rv_gdatu = <ls_cache>-gdatu` dereferences it; the class-data cache is also unbounded and never invalidated. The pattern praised as safe is the defect.
